caption:
NOT FOR POSTING: SAMPLE for the news drop format (the news is an unconfirmed report from Oct 19)

THE DROP: is purple coming back? 💜🦖

📰 SportsLogos.Net reports the Raptors will swap the black of the Statement jersey for purple, starting in 2027-28
🗓️ It started with an Oct 11 post from @ProLineMockups
🦖 Purple history: the original 1995 look, then the 30th season throwbacks in 2024-25
🎨 The shade, PMS 266, was picked to stay clear of the Lakers, Suns and Jazz
⚠️ The catch: neither the Raptors nor the NBA have said a word. We're in black at least through 2026-27

Purple or black? 👇

beats.vo: Purple is reportedly making its way back to our Raptors jerseys,
and it took over three decades to get here.
beats.dlg: AND IT TOOK OVER|3 DECADES TO GET HERE.

beats.vo: 1995, the original purple dino. 2024-25, the 30th season throwbacks. And next, a purple Statement jersey in 2027-28.

beats.label: @PROLINEMOCKUPS
beats.vo: It started with an October 11 post from ProLine Mockups.
beats.dlg: IT STARTED WITH AN OCT 11|POST FROM PROLINE MOCKUPS.

beats.vo: Here's what it replaces: the black and red Statement jersey we've worn since 2020-21.
beats.dlg: WHAT IT REPLACES: BLACK AND|RED, WORN SINCE 2020-21.

beats.vo: Chevron lettering and jagged pinstripes, a nod to the original dino set.
beats.dlg: CHEVRON LETTERING, JAGGED|PINSTRIPES: A NOD TO THE 90S.

beats.vo: The report says the black becomes purple. A colour swap, not a full rebrand.
beats.dlg: THE BLACK BECOMES PURPLE.|A COLOUR SWAP, NOT A REBRAND.

beats.vo: That purple, PMS 266, was picked to stay clear of the Lakers, Suns and Jazz.
beats.dlg: THAT PURPLE, PMS 266, DODGED|THE LAKERS, SUNS AND JAZZ.

beats.chipR: NO WORD FROM TEAM OR NBA
beats.vo: Neither the Raptors nor the NBA have said a word. And it wouldn't start until 2027-28.
beats.dlg: NO WORD FROM THE RAPTORS OR|THE NBA. NOT UNTIL 2027-28.

beats.vo: So this season, we're still in black. Purple or black? Tell us below.
beats.dlg: THIS SEASON: STILL BLACK.|PURPLE OR BLACK? COMMENT!

facts.claim: SportsLogos.Net (Oct 19, 2026): the Raptors 'will reportedly swap the black of their Statement Edition uniform for purple beginning in the 2027-28 season' (27-28); a colour swap, not a full rebrand; rumour from an October 11 (Oct 11, 2026, a Sunday) tweet by @ProLineMockups; 'neither the Raptors nor the NBA have said a word about it'; Raptors wear the black Statement uniforms at least one more season, 2026-27.

Purple was the primary colour when the team began in 1995; purple returned on throwback uniforms for the 30th season in 2024-25 (24-25). 1995 to 2027 = 32 years, more than 3 (three) decades. Short years on screen: '95 (1995), '24 (2024-25), '27 (2027-28).
Current black and red Statement Edition worn since 2020-21; chevron lettering and jagged pinstripes nod to the original mid-'90s (90s) dinosaur set
The shade, PMS 266, was chosen by Tom O'Grady to avoid colours worn by the Lakers, Suns and Jazz
